151.news_title: Pedal Assembly for your Arcade Lightgun!
151.long_description: Enhance your lightgun arcade machine with our Arcooda Pedal Assembly with programmable LED and USB support. Made from 2mm steel construction and a 4.5mm checker plate, the Arcooda gun pedal assembly is not painted, but powder coated for a sleek finish. Consisting of interchangeable parts from the original Namco arcade pedal assembly, the pedal has a programmable LED light circuit and LED back plate that allows light to shine through the front metal grill. The feature that makes this pedal really unique from the rest is the programmable LED lighting function. Using the LED Controller and remote control, switch the colors to whatever you want! There are many possibilities to enhance the visual of your arcade or homebrew lightgun set up! As our highest quality pedal, this microswitch version assembly is perfect for your arcade or home environment and is suitable for the following Namco shooter arcade machines: - Time Crisis 1 - Time Crisis 2 - Time Crisis 3 - Time Crisis 4 - Razing Storm - Crisis Zone - Blade of Honor We provide the opportunity for you to choose between standard wiring or a USB wiring harness. Standard wiring consists of a simple switch circuit which can be used for JAMMA game boards or simple switch-based homebrew machines. USB wiring offers a programmable pedal switch via connection to your computer. Furthermore, if you are using this foot pedal with your PC, order the Pedal Assembly Cable with Switch LED and USB Plug 200cm harness which has embedded chipset for when you plug it into an arcade or homebrew cabinet. Purchase now to upgrade your lightgun experience, stomp away!
